title: LeWiDi-2025 at NLPerspectives: Third Edition of the Learning with Disagreements Shared Task

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' ability to predict the subjective, individual label choices of specific human annotators (perspectivist prediction) and population-level label distributions (soft-label prediction) using annotator identifiers, past labeling behavior, and socio-demographic metadata (e.g., gender, age, nationality, ethnicity).
